option_decisions.memory_planner: Open: direct compile adapter and local memory-planning effect.
option_decisions.analyze_auto_scopes_for_deps: Open where reachable AUTO scopes are possible; false otherwise.
option_decisions.enable_pypto_l0c_double_buffer: Withheld: experimental PYPTO-only flag; known chained Mat-scratch operand-buffer overflow (#1908), not carried by RunConfig and JIT cache keys read outer context.
option_decisions.runtime: Withheld: changes runtime ABI, graph construction and worker binding; not an ordinary safe optimization control.
option_decisions.strategy: Fixed Default: installed version registers no alternative strategy.
option_decisions.ring_task_window: Open for task-producing a2a3 orchestration: 16384/32768 only, default 16384; no smaller windows or unbounded sizes.
option_decisions.aicpu_thread_num: Open for single-card task-producing a2a3 paths: 2/3/4, default 4 unless already overridden; withheld on distributed paths whose thread source differs.
option_decisions.ring_heap: Managed: affects output allocations; shrinking risks failures and increasing can exhaust HBM.
option_decisions.ring_dep_pool: Managed: dependency capacity; undersizing risks blocked scheduling; no demonstrated need to expose.
option_decisions.pass_options: Withheld: no typed installed RunConfig adapter; arbitrary pass removal/reordering can invalidate required IR invariants.
option_decisions.auto_scope: Source-level DSL control: already editable in Candidate decorators/scopes; no independent global RunConfig override. Must retain correct dependencies.
option_decisions.pipeline_stages_and_tile_shapes: Source-level DSL performance controls: Agent can edit Candidate pipeline/tile structure; not global compiler configuration.
option_decisions.program: Managed contract, target, artifact or diagnostic input; not an Agent performance control.
